item.title: India and France to Manufacture Everest-Capable Helicopters in India for Global Export: PM Modi
item.description: India and France upgraded their relationship to a "Special Global Strategic Partnership." Twenty-one key decisions were announced, including in defense, technology, and AI. The inauguration of a helicopter assembly line in Karnataka gave new impetus to "Make in India" and defense cooperation.

item.title: AI will not replace jobs, it will create new opportunities: PM Modi reassures youth amid rising concerns
item.description: Will AI take away jobs? PM Narendra Modi says no. Calling artificial intelligence a “job multiplier,” he assures India’s youth that technology will reshape work, not erase it as the government ramps up skilling and reskilling for an AI-driven future.

item.title: India invites Bangladesh’s new PM Tarique Rahman to New Delhi
item.description: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla met with the new Prime Minister of Bangladesh, Tarique Rahman, and presented him with a congratulatory letter from PM Modi and an invitation to visit India. Emphasis was placed on strengthening bilateral relations with the new government.

item.title: BAFTA 2026: Alia Bhatt turns presenter alongside Cillian Murphy; Details inside
item.description: Alia Bhatt is set to present at BAFTA 2026 alongside global stars like Cillian Murphy, while Manipuri film Boong earns a major nomination. It’s a proud moment for Indian cinema on one of the world’s biggest film stages.

item.title: Weather Update: IMD issues yellow alert in Delhi; Air quality improves slightly
item.description: The IMD has issued a yellow alert, forecasting light rain in the morning followed by moderate showers accompanied by thunderstorms in the afternoon. Wind speeds may reach 30-40 kmph at times. Light rainfall is also likely during the evening hours.

item.title: Gold climbs near Rs1.53 Lakh; Key resistance seen at Rs1.55 lakh
item.description: The Indian Bullion Jewellers Association (IBJA) fixed the standard gold price at ₹1,51,865 per 10 grams (999 purity) during its February 17 evening session, down 1.45% from ₹1,54,098 in the previous session.

item.title: EC announces March 16 poll date for 37 Rajya Sabha seats across 10 states
item.description: Among the states going to polls, Maharashtra will see elections for seven seats, while West Bengal and Bihar will each have five seats up for election.

item.title: AI Impact Summit: Finland PM Petteri Orpo joins global event; Sundar Pichai to deliver keynote
item.description: The visit is expected to deepen India–Finland cooperation in digital innovation, artificial intelligence, sustainable development, and education.

item.title: Double Blow To Pakistan: After Indus, India to stop Ravi waters as well
item.description: For the last many years, excess water from the Ravi river has often flowed into Pakistan because of insufficient storage facilities in our country. But from April this situation may change.
